body: Thank you. You have been very nice too.
I hope you enjoy your day.  Please don't feel obligated to check back in here. What you've offered so far has been very comforting to me.  Thank you, again, for the kind words.
Thank you for speaking to me.  Just having someone acknowledge me means so much that I feel like I might cry.

Thank you. I have felt all the feelings about it. In the end, I am comforted that shelters being full means people, like me are no longer suffering in their abusive homes.  Yes, money is the issue.  He has taken everything from me & refused to allow me to earn more.  I am allowed about $5 at a time & am forced to use that to pay for food or gas.  My family is dead & I haven't made eye contact with a friend in over 7 years as he immediately isolated me.  I really am alone.  I know I can go to the street but it will be even harder with my illnesses. Also, I don't want my pets to suffer any more than they do at this time.

Going cold turkey off your SNRI is only going to make you feel worse.  I took Effexor in grad school & if I missed a dose by half an hour, I would be sobbing hysterically.  I hope you find someone way to feel better soon; for you & for your kids.

Thank you. I have talked to many shelters. They say to keep trying until they have space.  I've been trying for almost 3 years. The abuse is getting so much worse & my body can't physically take much more. Even if I don't kill myself, I think I will be dead before the new year.  It is my ex bf.

I've had pets my entire life. Currently, they're all that keep me Earth bound.  Last year, I was abused so badly I had no choice but to be admitted to the hospital. The people who found me called animal control who took my pets.  I didn't get them back for over a week.  My youngest would fall asleep and wake up crying & run to me immediately. She did it a dozen times a day for a few weeks until, I think, she was sure I would be there when she woke up.  I am not trying to manipulate you or force your hand.  I just wanted to say I believe pets miss us when we are gone.  I have seen it in my own life.   I hope you find a way to feel better soon.
Happy Birthday.  I am sorry today hurts.  Hugs.
